Pakistan All Out for 110 in Lord's Test Against England

In a Test match at Lord's, the Pakistan cricket team was bowled out for 110 runs. Eight of their batsmen failed to score in double digits. Following this, England built a lead of 261 runs. The coverage highlights the low score and the performance of the batsmen.
